proposed_fixed_observation: Original-ranking official feedback for q[id]=p_final_v82[id]-2*(takeoff_final[id]-takeoff_old[id]) on all original IDs; no new vector was computed by this review.

novelty.finding: No exact earlier official experiment found in capped index search. Existing inverse/back-transform hits concern synthetic clock-transform checks and old-input reconstruction, not scoring a final-input portable prediction after fixed reverse transport. This is not proof of exhaustive absence.

conditional_information.exact_algebra: If y_final=y_old+2dt and no projection/clipping changes either recipe, q-y_old=p_final_v82-y_final. Therefore its official original-ranking RMSE equals that final model shared-row RMSE.
conditional_information.decision_relevance: Compare q official score to v80 official score. The final-v82-all-rows option and the retained v80+2dt/shared plus v82/nonshared hybrid have identical nonshared values, so the shared MSE ordering determines whole-final ordering under this assumption.
conditional_information.no_departure_proof: The official score cannot establish the hidden departure block transformation. A good score may result despite an incorrect assumed phase map. No real paired-departure Jan/Jul validation is created.
conditional_information.rounded_residual: Writing r=delta_block+dt gives y_final=y_old+2dt-r. Final shared MSE difference between portable and transported v80 equals MSE(q,y_old)-MSE(v80,y_old)+2*mean((q-v80)*r). If |r|<=1 were also valid for departures, the absolute unknown term is at most2*RMS(q-v80). Arrival evidence does not prove this departure bound.
conditional_information.serialization: p_final_v82 and dt are integer, so subtraction adds no rounding error. Nonnegative clipping can destroy exact inverse/error equivalence; any implementation must count and explicitly handle it before interpreting an official score.

cheap_necessary_filters_if_authorized.duplicate: Require actual integer vector nonduplication against prior submissions and exact shared-ID/source mapping. No duplicate scan run in this review.
cheap_necessary_filters_if_authorized.distance_bound: For D=RMS(q-p_old_v82), reverse triangle inequality gives RMSE(q)>=RMSE(p_old_v82)-D. Using root-provided displayed official scores221.5240 and218.8525, D below2.6715s rules out beating v80, subject to display rounding. If D is larger, improvement is only possible, not established.
cheap_necessary_filters_if_authorized.scope: These would be input/prediction-only safeguards for a separately authorized one-shot candidate, not a weight/coefficient scan. No arrays decoded or new distance computed here.

CV_and_selection.CV: Inherited direct-model Jan/Jul score belongs only to its parent recipe. The reverse transport has no genuine paired Jan/Jul CV; final_recovery/root must resolve admissibility under the user CV rule without relabelling parent or synthetic metrics.
CV_and_selection.selection: If admissible and materially distinct, this is a credible conditional final-selection experiment, so final choice may remain provisional for one fixed comparison. It does not establish a plausible205 route by itself.
CV_and_selection.fallback: If not admissible or the necessary filters fail, the strongest retained evidence remains the already-audited hybrid: v80 transported on shared IDs, best officially measured portable parent v82 on nonshared IDs, with the phase assumption explicitly preserved.
